product_one_liner.value: Authentic8’s Silo Workspace provides secure, anonymous web access and investigation tools for intelligence, security, law-enforcement, and other investigative teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes secure, anonymous online investigations; product information identifies intelligence and security teams as intended users.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists per-user annual prices for multiple Silo Workspace plans.

named_customers.notes: The success stories page and case studies disclose fewer than two customer names; one case study identifies Navy Cyber Defense Operations Command (NCDOC), while other stories are anonymized. Per the requested rule, the list is empty.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 124 employees; that falls in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Redwood City as headquarters; the company site gives its Redwood City address.

founded_year.notes: The company LinkedIn profile lists its founding year as 2010.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows investigative-use, product, and industry content, but not at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Authentic8 has a public support knowledge base with multiple product documentation categories and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles listed are Governance Administration Specialist and Sales Development Representative, with no AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The AI information describes Silo Nexus AI and use of public AI/LLM models, but does not name a specific model or provider. The reviewed help center, blog, and privacy policy also do not identify one.

compliance_certs.notes: These five are explicitly named on the certifications page; only the requested certification names are included.

last_funding.notes: Vistara announced a US$12 million debt facility on October 8, 2025; funding profiles identify this as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The US$12 million debt investment was announced October 8, 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job listing includes Sales Development Representative, Commercial.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 20, 2026 release introduced Silo Nexus AI v2 and substantial investigation-role and workflow features, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page is a small, checkable roster and reports no C-level or VP-level arrival within the period; it does not announce a departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable support and integrations materials name systems such as Okta, ADFS, Duo, OneLogin, Active Directory, and Splunk, but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
